name: cannibal.live_world_night_local_contact_pack_mcw
description: Scenario 2 for cannibal camp night-raid live matrix: an audited idle cannibal_camp at the fixture-installed nearby terrain anchor starts with one returned smoke lead backed by a physical nearby fire/smoke disturbance, then enters the real active-sortie dispatch and local-contact path on the night cadence boundary. The fixture supplies no active outing or product transition; the gate consumes only the distinct committed dispatch and contact events.

steps.label: post_load_night_pack_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-load gameplay screen for McWilliams cannibal night local-contact fixture; this is startup/load evidence plus before-action screen proof, not feature closure by itself
steps.failure_rule: If the gameplay screen is not visible after load, later dispatch/local-contact artifacts cannot be credited.

steps.label: preflight_observed_idle_cannibal_dispatch_footing
steps.abort_reason: the saved cannibal site was not the observed idle two-member, zero-outing causal boundary
steps.expected_immediate_state: the fixture-installed cannibal anchor has two ready members, no active outing or target, and one returned smoke lead backed by the physical nearby disturbance before the real cadence turn

steps.label: pass_one_turn_on_night_dispatch_boundary
steps.expected_visible_fact: one player pass-turn input has completed on the night local-contact fixture; feature credit depends on the separate same-run committed active-sortie dispatch and local-contact event records, not on the before/after screen alone
steps.failure_rule: If the pass-turn input is unproven, or either committed active-sortie event is absent or fails its identity-continuity predicate, this scenario is not product proof.

steps.label: advance_500_turns_for_cannibal_contact
steps.expected_visible_fact: the derived 50-minute physical approach window has completed for a ten-OMT route at the authoritative five-minute overmap-NPC cadence; feature credit requires the committed local-contact event with the dispatch identity
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded approach input is unproven or no identity-continuous committed local-contact event appears, the route remains red.

evidence_contract.claim: an idle two-member cannibal site at the observed night foothold can be credited only by real committed active-sortie dispatch followed by committed local contact
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for cannibal behavior
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No feature-proof credit if startup/load, the preflighted idle cannibal site, pass-turn ledger, or either committed structured event and its continuity identity is missing or non-green.
